_metadata.notes: Tracks all experiments with metadata for reproducibility

exp_501.description: MIL reframe: binary classification (gamma=1, delta=0) on glioma_mil.h5 -- exp_201's dataset-migrated counterpart

exp_607.description: Suite 600 follow-up: flat beta=0.25, 120 epochs, full suite (TRTR reused from exp_501)

exp_608.description: Suite 600 follow-up: flat beta=0.5, 120 epochs, full suite (TRTR reused from exp_501)

exp_609.description: Suite 600 follow-up: flat beta=0.75, 120 epochs, full suite (TRTR reused from exp_501)

exp_601.description: Suite 600 CVAE beta tuning: beta=1.0 (exp_501's baseline is beta=2.0)

exp_2.608.description: v2-preprocessing replication of exp_608: same settings (beta=0.5, 120 epochs), new dataset (glioma-preproc-2.h5), full retrain -- nothing transferred

exp_2.607.description: v2-preprocessing replication of exp_607: same settings (beta=0.25, 120 epochs), new dataset (glioma-preproc-2.h5), full retrain -- nothing transferred

exp_2.609.description: v2-preprocessing replication of exp_609: same settings (beta=0.75, 120 epochs), new dataset (glioma-preproc-2.h5), full retrain -- nothing transferred
exp_2.609.notes: Completes the v2 beta sweep alongside exp_2.607/exp_2.608.

exp_4.608.description: v3-preprocessing (fixed threshold=0.4) replication of exp_608: same settings (beta=0.5, 120 epochs), new dataset (glioma-preproc-3.h5), full retrain -- nothing transferred
exp_4.608.notes: New preprocessing pipeline (v3): fixed max-intensity threshold (0.4) replacing v2's adaptive mask, same automated spirit. Confirmed v1's current default dataset already corresponds to threshold=0.6 (strong_signal_mask.npy provenance). Policy: GPU-only Modal jobs (CVAE/CNN); CPU-parallel MIL work (mi-SVM, etc.) stays local for this experiment family.

exp_701.description: Latent-dim ablation (article S8.III): latent_dim=16, otherwise identical to exp_608 (beta=0.5, 120 epochs, TRTR reused from exp_501)
exp_701.notes: Article S8.III ablation, latent_dim in {16,32,64} -- exp_608 is the 32 point. Only cvae.latent_dim differs from exp_608. GPU-only Modal policy (CVAE/CNN); TRTR reused from exp_501.

exp_702.description: Latent-dim ablation (article S8.III): latent_dim=64, otherwise identical to exp_608 (beta=0.5, 120 epochs, TRTR reused from exp_501)
exp_702.notes: Article S8.III ablation, latent_dim in {16,32,64} -- exp_608 is the 32 point. Only cvae.latent_dim differs from exp_608. GPU-only Modal policy (CVAE/CNN); TRTR reused from exp_501.

exp_703.description: Reconstruction-loss ablation (article S8.III): gamma=0.5/delta=0.5, otherwise identical to exp_608 (beta=0.5, 120 epochs, TRTR reused from exp_501)
exp_703.notes: Article S8.III ablation, recon loss in {pure MSE, 0.5/0.5, pure cos} -- exp_608 is the pure-MSE point. GPU-only Modal policy; TRTR reused from exp_501. Queued behind exp_701/702 remediation.

exp_704.description: Reconstruction-loss ablation (article S8.III): gamma=0.0/delta=1.0 (pure cosine), otherwise identical to exp_608 (beta=0.5, 120 epochs, TRTR reused from exp_501)
exp_704.notes: Article S8.III ablation, recon loss in {pure MSE, 0.5/0.5, pure cos} -- exp_608 is the pure-MSE point. GPU-only Modal policy; TRTR reused from exp_501. Queued behind exp_703.

exp_705.description: Synth/real ratio ablation (article S8.III): ratio=0.5, otherwise identical to exp_608 (CVAE/TRTR/TSTR reused unchanged, only TSRTR+stats_eval run fresh)
exp_705.notes: Article S8.III ablation, synth/real ratio in {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} -- exp_608 is the 1.0 point. Cheapest ablation here: no CVAE/TSTR retrain. Queued behind exp_704.

exp_706.description: Synth/real ratio ablation (article S8.III): ratio=2.0, otherwise identical to exp_608 (CVAE/TRTR/TSTR reused unchanged, only TSRTR+stats_eval run fresh)
exp_706.notes: Article S8.III ablation, synth/real ratio in {0.5, 1.0, 2.0} -- exp_608 is the 1.0 point. Queued behind exp_705.

exp_708.description: TSTR with 2x synthetic data: pool 40000/class (exp_608 has 20000/class), generated from exp_608 decoders, otherwise identical to exp_608 TSTR (beta=0.5; only synth_gen+TSTR+stats_eval run fresh)

exp_707.description: Synth/real ratio ablation (article S8.III): ratio=3.0, otherwise identical to exp_608 (beta=0.5, same CVAE/TRTR/TSTR reused, only TSRTR+stats_eval run fresh)
